page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY.
D 6627
Date 23 / 4 / 35

According to reliable information it was reported that the communistic
arm badge and a blue cloth badge of Zung Tien Ming, alias Zung Dah Foo are
contained in one of the criminal letters of which the envelope describes
as "urgent letter addressed to Zung Tsi Foo, from Zung, October 4th."
which is kept in a small box underneath a leather suit case inside a
cupboard in front of a bed in the bed-room divided from the home of Yang
Ai Lien prostitute at No. 47 Elgin Road under a district of your jurisdic-
tion. Another communistic badge of Zung Tien Ming is concealed in the
pocket inside the cover of that leather suit case.

Zung Yih King, the father and Zung Zau Sz the mother of Zung Tien Ming
are residing at No. 414 French Bund, a house facing east. You will
find the scalp blood of a stork packed with a sheet of white paper stuck
amidst the straw inside a salt cabbage urn after having knocked off the
plaster which seals the mouth of the urn by digging the ground for about
one foot from the place under the water vessel on the left side of the
kitchen. The stork blood was used by Zung Tien Ming in poisoning Tseu
Ah Hoo the sweetheart of his mother Zung Zau Sz, alias Ah Chio. Tseu Ah
Hoo alias Tseu Tuh Piau native of Yien Zeng of Kompo who after having been
poisoned was secretly buried on the tomb of Tong Zoong Sai, about three
steps in front of the maple trees. He the owner of Tong Zoong Sai's
tomb, you may ask Tong Wai Hsueh or his son Tong Tseng Chyoh at No. 120
Rue Hue, French Concession.

The communistic firearms may be found in the wooden box under the
moving floor of a secret room on the south side of the red dotted line.

Search of the premises may be conducted with the assistance of two
sketches. As it is perfectly confidential, no other documents will be
prepared.
(Signed) Choh Zeu Nyen from Zangzoh.
Administration Bureau of Shanghai
Special Area.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别科登记处。
D 6627
日期 1935年4月23日

据可靠消息报告，共产主义臂章及一块写有 Zung Tien Ming（音译），别名 Zung Dah Foo（音译）的蓝布徽章，藏于一封刑事信件中，该信信封上注明为“Zung（音译）于10月4日致 Zung Tsi Foo（音译）的急件”。此信存放于一个置于皮箱内的小盒中，该皮箱位于阁下辖区爱尔金路（Elgin Road）47号妓女杨爱莲（Yang Ai Lien）住所卧室内床前的橱柜里。另一枚属于 Zung Tien Ming（音译）的共产主义徽章藏于该皮箱盖内的口袋中。

Zung Tien Ming（音译）之父 Zung Yih King（音译）及其母 Zung Zau Sz（音译）居住于法租界外滩414号，房屋坐东朝西。在厨房左侧水缸下方，向地面挖掘约一尺，敲开密封菜坛口的灰泥后，你会发现坛内稻草中夹着一张白纸包裹的鹳鸟头皮血。此鹳鸟血系 Zung Tien Ming（音译）用于毒杀其母 Zung Zau Sz（音译，别名 Ah Chio（音译））的情人 Tseu Ah Hoo（音译）。Tseu Ah Hoo（音译，别名 Tseu Tuh Piau（音译））系江苏昆山（Kompo, Kiangsu）严增（Yien Zeng，音译）人，中毒后被秘密埋葬在 Tong Zoong Sai（音译）墓前枫树前三步处。关于 Tong Zoong Sai（音译）墓的业主情况，你可询问法租界霞飞路（Rue Hue）120号的 Tong Wai Hsueh（音译）或其子 Tong Tseng Chyoh（音译）。

共产主义枪支可在红色虚线南侧密室的活动地板下的木箱中找到。

搜查该处所可依据两份草图进行。此事绝对机密，故不另备其他文件。
（签名）来自 Zangzoh（音译）的 Choh Zeu Nyen（音译）。
上海特区行政局。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2, Special Branch,
REPORT
File No. B. REGI
Date... April 16, 1935.

Subject... Letter received by Municipal Police disclosing addresses of alleged
communists at 414 Garden Bridge and 47 Elgin Road.
Made by... and... Forwarded by... D.I. Everest.

I forward herewith a fifth letter on the subject of
alleged communist bases at 414 Garden Bridge and 47 Elgin Road.
A translation of the letter, which is in the same handwriting
as the previous ones, is given hereunder:-
"Officer i/c Louza Police Station,
"I beg to inform you confidentially that
"letters written by individuals murdered by hypnotism
"by Zung Tien Ming (陳天民) alias Zung Dah Fu
"(陳達夫); communist credentials and armlets, as
"well as communist firearms are hidden in house
"No. 47 Elgin Road. As delay will be incurred if
"this is carried out through the usual course of
"procedure, I enclose a plan herewith with the
"request that a search be effected. Zung Tien Ming
"resides at No. 414, Garden Bridge, French Concession.
"His father is Zung Yih Ming (陳一鳴) and his mother
"is Zung Zao Sz (陳趙氏). In case he escapes from
"No. 414 Garden Bridge, he can be located at No. 87A
"Range Road. There you will also find letters
"written by individuals murdered by hypnotism which
"are hidden in a box belonging to Zung Tien Ming
"beneath a bed in his bedroom.

(Signed) Chow Tuh Piau (周德標),
Chinese detective at Soochow."

D. C. (Special Branch).
D. I.

Date April 4 1935.

Subject Letter received by Municipal Police disclosing addresses of alleged communists at 414 Garden Bridge and 47 Elgin Road.

Made by and Forwarded by D. I. Everest

The following is a translation of a letter (unsigned) addressed to the Shanghai Municipal Police which was received on April 2, 1935 :-

"Shanghai Municipal Police,
Sir,
I beg to inform you confidentially that
"Zung Tien Ming (陈天明) is a member of the Chinese
"Communist Party. His father is Zung Yin Ming
"(陈一鸣) and his mother is Zung Lao Oo (陈老欧).
"The trio reside at 414 Garden Bridge. Firearms
"belonging to the Communist Party are concealed
"underneath the ground in the compound at the rear
"of the Western Wing of the house. Zung's party
"credentials are hidden in an aperture behind a bed
"in Yung Ai Lien's (杨爱莲) bedroom which is situated
"in the 3rd room back of 47 Elgin Road. If you
"lift the curtain, you will notice the door of the
"aperture which will open after being turned to the
"right three times. There you will find a small
"case, wrench off the lock and you will find letters
"therein. In the last letter addressed by Zung Chih
"Fu (陈智夫), you will find communist credentials and
"party armlets. Please effect an immediate arrest.
(Signed) Loh Zao Feng (陆兆丰)."

A copy of a plan of the house at 47 Elgin Road, which was enclosed in the letter, is attached to this report.

The letter was posted in Zangzoh (常熟) on March 31, and is in the same hand-writing as the letter passed to this office by the French Police on April 2 (vide attached report).

made before any definite action is taken.

D. I. Everest
D. I.
